info.title: Account-to-Account (A2A) payments API
info.description:
The A2A payments API provides endpoints for A2A payment flows, enabling issuers to facilitate direct payments through Adyen for users with an Adyen business account.

With these endpoints, you can:
- **Retrieve payment details**: Retrieve transaction information for specific payments.
- **Confirm payments**: Confirm payments with Strong Customer Authentication (SCA).
- **Cancel payments**: Cancel pending transactions.

## Authentication
Each request made to the A2A Payments API must be signed with an API key. Generate an API key in your Customer Area.

To connect to the API, add an `X-API-Key` header with the API key as the value, for example:

 ```
curl
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-H "X-API-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" \
...
```

## Roles and permissions
To use the A2A Payments API, your API credential must have the following roles:
- **Role for A2A Issuer payments - API**

Reach out to your Adyen contact to set up these roles.
## Going live
When going live, generate an API key in your [live Customer Area](https://ca-live.adyen.com/ca). You can then use the API key to send requests to `https://balanceplatform-api-live.adyen.com/a2aissuer-api/v{version}/payments`.

post.description:
Confirms the payment using Strong Customer Authentication (SCA).

    To confirm a payment you must make this request two times:

    1. Make this request to initiate SCA and receive the WWW-Authenticate header.
    2. After the user completes the SCA challenge, make this request again, including the updated WWW-Authenticate header.

    The second response provides a redirection URL that guides the user to a payment success or failure page.
For more information, see our [documentation](https://docs.adyen.com/business-accounts/send-funds-ideal-integration).

parameters.name: WWW-Authenticate
parameters.description: Header for authenticating through SCA: Contains information for an SCA challenge for A2A payments.

Confirm payment request..description: Specifies the token for the payment to be confirmed, and a balanceAccountid to pay with.

Confirm payment response..description: Specifies the link to where the user should be redirected to. Will contain a `success` link if payment was made succesfully, and a `cancel` if it failed.

post.description: Returns the details of an open payment, which you must show to the user. Also provides a token required to [confirm](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/a2a-payments/latest/post/payments/confirm) or [cancel](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/a2a-payments/latest/post/payments/cancel) the payment.

Retrieve payment details request - iDEAL.summary: Retrieve payment details request for a payment with iDEAL.
Retrieve payment details request - iDEAL.description: Specifies the method, source and payload to retrieve payment details for a payment with iDEAL.

Retrieve payment details response..description: Returns a details object with the amount, counterparty, description and expiration of the payment, and a token required for the requests to confirm or cancel the payment.

links.description: Contains redirection URLs to guide the user to the appropriate page, after a successful payment or a cancellation.

token.description: The payment token is an identifier for the payment. It is generated by Adyen on the response of the payment details.

links.description: Contains redirection URLs to guide the user to the appropriate page, after a successful payment or a cancellation.

accountHolder.description: Contains the full name of the person or entity that receives the payment funds).

accountIdentification.description: Contains the account number to which the payment funds are sent.

DefaultErrorResponseEntity.description: Standardized error response following RFC-7807 format

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.

instance.description: A URI that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem if applicable.

invalidFields.description: Array of fields with validation errors when applicable.

requestId.description: The unique reference for the request.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type.

type.description: A URI that identifies the validation error type. It points to human-readable documentation for the problem type.

href.description: The full URL for the redirection.

iban.description: The IBAN of the bank account.

accountHolderId.description: The unique identifier of the account holder.

redirectUrl.description: A short-lived URL that redirects the user to the iDEAL profile management page.

accountHolderId.description: The unique identifier for an account holder.

payload.description: A payload provided by iDEAL to complete the authentication process.

redirectUrl.description: A short-lived URL that redirects the user to the iDEAL page that is required for authentication.

payload.description: An identifier for the payment, generated by the payment method, such as iDEAL. This is obtained from the specified `source`.

source.description: The source used to obtain the payload. Possible values: `qr`, `redirect`, and `pushNotification`.

name.description: The field that has an invalid value.

cancel.description: The URL to where the user must be redirected after a payment has been canceled.

success.description: The URL to where the user must be redirected after a successful payment.

counterparty.description: Contains information about the party that receives the payment funds.

description.description: The description for the payment. It is generated by the payment method, such as iDEAL, and should be shown to the user.

expiresAt.description:
The expiration date of the payment in ISO DateTime format, as described on ISO 20022 (YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss.sss+/-hh:mm).

Example: **2025-12-30T14:15:30+01:00**

method.description: The payment method for the transaction.

details.description: The details of the payment. You must show your user these details before they confirm or cancel the payment.

token.description: The token that identifies the payment. It is generated by Adyen and is needed to confirm or cancel the payment.

accountHolderId.description: The unique identifier of the account holder.

paymentInstrumentIds.description: The unique identifiers of the payment instruments to be associated with the iDEAL profile.

redirectUrl.description: A short-lived URL that redirects the user to the iDEAL profile registration page.
